Percepts are a fresh context u, a sticky nuisance v and the outcome y of the last action, which succeeds when it matches u. A memory that keeps u and acts on it makes every outcome a success, so the next percept says nothing about u: its nostalgia is its whole content, ln 2 per step in the noiseless limit. The same memory with the action fixed lets the outcome reveal u, and its nostalgia is 0. Its heat per step is the same, because the policy only moves dissipation between the switch and the relaxation. Without feedback a memory's nostalgia is fixed by the memory and the drive; with feedback the use that makes the memory worth having is what makes it nonpredictive. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
